reports.title: Ultra Clean Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Outlook
section: The Company expects revenue in the range of $800 million to $860 million. The Company expects GAAP diluted net income per share to be between $1.02 and $1.26, and non-GAAP diluted net income per share to be between $1.11 and $1.35.
